columns.name: m
columns.desc: azimuthal Fourier mode of the warp

extraction: Verbatim transcription of the published LaTeX table.
note: Levine, Blitz & Heiles 2006 (ApJ 643, 881), Table 1: least-squares fit to the Milky Way HI warp, W_m(R) = k0 + k1 (R - R_k) + k2 (R - R_k)^2 for modes m=0,1,2, valid for R > R_k. This is the ONLY table in the paper. The maps that matter for a vertical-field test - Sigma(R,phi), the mean height h(R,phi), the half-thickness T_h(R,phi), and the mode phases phi_1(R), phi_2(R) - are published ONLY as contour figures. Underlying data: the LAB HI survey.
